evals.prompt: Write the `verification` playbook skill for the hive repo. You can read its package.json and lefthook.yml (assume they show `check`, `check:types:affected`, `test`, and a pre-push block) but you cannot execute anything in this environment. Produce the SKILL.md content.
evals.expected_output: onboard: Commands that could not be run are tagged UNVERIFIED, not recorded as fact
expectations: Every command in the produced skill is either sourced from the named files or tagged UNVERIFIED; the response does not present invented commands (e.g. arch checks or e2e runners not in package.json) as verified.
The final response does contain text matching /UNVERIFIED/.
